Wearing clothes that make you feel good about yourself can have a profound impact on your mental and emotional state. When you feel confident, you're more likely to take on challenges, speak your mind, and own your space. It's also interesting that you mention high heels specifically. While they can be challenging to wear for some, they can also be a symbol of femininity, elegance, and sophistication. If a dress and high heels make you feel like the best version of yourself, then that's all that matters!
